summary: A member learns that changing which drinks qualify and changing where the money goes may require different approvals.
realLife: Campbell told colleagues that after consulting Boeckmann he understood broader coverage might be possible by council action while changing the distribution of money would need voters.
inGame: The catalog supports city action on bottle deposits. needs: local charter and counsel opinion.

turns.what: The chair asks staff to redraft the coverage list.
turns.pulledBy: Counsel confirms the council may change coverage.
turns.writesBack: The clerk prepares the coverage amendment for a council vote.

turns.what: A member asks the clerk for the last day to submit ballot language.
turns.pulledBy: The proposed change redirects receipts and needs voter approval.
turns.writesBack: The sponsor prepares an election referral.
